challenge: Execution of a large parking facility with complex roof geometry requiring accurate sandwich panel coordination, controlled rainwater drainage management, waterproofing continuity, and long-term corrosion resistance in a humid coastal environment.
sipanel_solution: SIPANEL designed a coordinated sandwich panel roofing and drainage system including engineered gutters, optimized roof slopes, controlled water flow paths, and waterproofing integration to ensure reliable rainwater performance.
engineering_decision: Engineering teams optimized drainage slopes, gutter positioning, downspout coordination, and sandwich panel alignment to improve water evacuation efficiency and reduce long-term maintenance risks.
execution_detail: Roof panels, gutters, flashing systems, and downspouts were installed according to engineered drainage details using controlled alignment procedures, fastening checkpoints, and waterproof sealing verification workflows.
measured_result: Successful delivery of a durable sandwich panel roofing system with reliable rainwater management, long-term weather protection, and controlled drainage performance.
primary_message: Engineered sandwich panel roofing systems designed for controlled drainage performance and long-term durability.
